enchantments.tooltip: +6 Orb Bonus: While this orb is equipped and you are actively blocking, you gain a +6 orb bonus to all saving throws, as well as Acid, Cold, Fire, Electric, and Sonic resistances.
Spell Focus II: +2 Equipment bonus to the DC of all spells.
Spell Penetration III: Passive: +3 Equipment bonus to Spell Penetration checks.

Elemental Absorption +10%: Passive: 10% Enhancement Bonus to Acid, Cold, Fire, and Electrical Absorption. (Absorption reduces damage from an element by a percentage, after resistance have been taken into account.)

enchantments.text: One of the following Spell Power bonuses:

children.tooltip: Combustion +114: Passive: +114 Equipment bonus to Fire Spell Power.
Corrosion +114: Passive: +114 Equipment bonus to Acid Spell Power.
Glaciation +114: Passive: +114 Equipment bonus to Cold Spell Power.
Impulse +114: Passive: +114 Equipment bonus to Force, Untyped, Slashing, Piercing, and Bludgeoning Spell Power.
Magnetism +114: Passive: +114 Equipment bonus to Electricity Spell Power.

enchantments.text: Mythic Weapon Boost +2 or +4 and/or Mythic Shield Boost +2 or +4
enchantments.tooltip: Mythic Weapon Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)Mythic Shield Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
